description: Fully local audio-to-text in the visitor's own browser tab. Speech is transcribed (and optionally translated) by models running on WebGPU/WASM in the page — no audio ever reaches the server. Engines: Whisper (transformers.js, light default), LiquidAI LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B-ONNX (onnxruntime-web, from the liquidai catalog) and LFM2.5-350M as an in-tab translation post-pass. The API is thin: the liquidai catalog filtered to what a tab can run, plus an MCP server (stdio and streamable HTTP at POST /mcp).

/models.docs: Browser-runnable models from the liquidai catalog (?kind=audio|text)

/engines.docs: The in-browser engines this app ships, with sizes and requirements

/transcribe.docs: Server-side convenience path only — forwards to liquidai /transcribe. The browser path never calls this.

/mcp.docs: MCP streamable HTTP — claude mcp add --transport http voice http://localhost:50980/mcp

/.docs: The app: record or drop audio, transcribe and translate in-tab
